tasks.label: qa:test-headless-logged
args: if (Test-Path test-run.log) { Remove-Item test-run.log -Force }; corepack pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --reporter=append-only *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath test-run.log -Append; corepack pnpm ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless --progress=false *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath test-run.log -Append; Write-Output "DONE" | Tee-Object -FilePath test-run.log -Append
